title: U.S. Census Geography Foundation
description: Versioned EPSG:4326 polygons and geocoded indexes for nationwide, state-equivalent, county-equivalent, and ZCTA geography.
publication_manifest: The runtime pointer's manifest field resolves relative to data/geography.

spatial_zip_polygon_denominator.selection_scope: complete selected Census-published ZCTA5 polygon set for the declared source layer and vintage

usps_operational_zip_evidence.relationship: A same-code USPS ZIP5 assignment may supplement routing status but does not create, replace, or alter a Census ZCTA5 polygon.

compatibility: Additive normalized fields are backward compatible within schema version 1; identifier, coordinate-order, or semantic changes require a major version.
